text:
ada: FYI onboarding run for mistralx-30b-v2-q4 is hitting intermittent slow generation and memory spikes on int4 canary runs. seeing single-request tails spike to 4-6s and occasional OOMs.
rafael: ugh. is this during long generations or short ones?
ada: mostly >512 tokens, tends to appear around 700-1200 token mark. short ones fine. logs show fragmentation and repeated allocator retries.
priya: do we have the exact build/quant settings? any diff vs other 30b models that are fine?
ada: same quant toolchain as other int4 models but model has wider attention params + new rotary mix. config: 
```
model: mistralx-30b-v2-q4
quant: int4-static
kv_prefetch: enabled
batching: adaptive
max_new_tokens_default: 1024
warmup_tokens: 256
```
zhang: KV prefetch + large max_new_tokens could be killing us. prefetch can bloat memory if compaction isn't aggressive.
oliver: also check slot compactor thresholds. If compactor runs too rarely, fragmentation accumulates across sessions.
ada: here's a representative snippet from the agent logs right before an OOM: 
```
[2026-03-18T14:12:23Z] Alloc failed: requester=gen-req-342 size=48MB arena=2
[2026-03-18T14:12:23Z] KV cache growth detected: new_slots=2048 current_used=78% total_slots=8192
[2026-03-18T14:12:23Z] Prefetch reserved=120MB active=96MB
[2026-03-18T14:12:23Z] Eviction loop started, evicted=0, fragmentation=34%
[2026-03-18T14:12:24Z] OOM: cannot satisfy allocation
```
rafael: fragmentation 34% is high but not catastrophic. the key is 'evicted=0' — evict policy might be mismatched (ttl vs lru).
priya: quick mitigations we can try on canary: lower max_new_tokens_default to 512, disable kv_prefetch for int4 variant, and increase compactor frequency. doable as non-breaking runtime flags.
ada: agreed. I can push a canary patch to change defaults for 5% of traffic.
zhang: also add an adaptive eviction policy: prefer evicting cold prefixes first and fall back to partial-kv-trim for long sessions. that should reduce the 'evicted=0' case.
oliver: for immediate runs, try setting `compactor_interval_ms=30000` and `kv_eviction_batch=128`. we should watch tail latency.
priya: will add an eval suite that simulates generation up to 2k tokens with mixed prompt lengths to catch regressions.
ada: timeline: I'll roll the defaults change to canary in ~30m, run 1000 synthetic sessions, then roll to 20% if stable. posting metrics hooks to #eng-metrics.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-config-update to mistralx-30b-v2-q4 -> will apply in 30 minutes. CI checks passed.
rafael: if OOM persists after disabling prefetch, we should instrument allocator to dump free list histograms and run a small fuzz harness to reproduce fragmentation pattern.
priya: noted. I'll prepare the fuzz harness and a prompt suite (length distribution + temperature sweep).
ada: action items recap: (1) ada: roll canary defaults (max_new_tokens=512, kv_prefetch=off) (2) oliver: set compactor_interval_ms=30000 + kv_eviction_batch=128 (3) priy a: create synthetic evals + fuzz harness (4) zhang: prototype adaptive eviction policy.
zhang: timeline ok. I'll open an RFC for eviction algo with perf targets.
oliver: we'll also add a short-term dashboard with fragmentation %, evicted_count, allocator-retries, and tail P95 gen latency.
ada: thanks all. will post canary link and test results in ~1.5h. :thumbsup:
